title: Add Rich Text Editor
content: Create WYSIWYG text editor. Toolbar: flex flex-wrap gap-1 p-2 border-b bg-gray-50. Toolbar buttons: p-2 rounded hover:bg-gray-200, icons for bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, lists, links, headings. Button groups: separated by dividers. Editor area: min-h-[200px] p-4 focus:outline-none, contentEditable div or textarea. Formatting: execCommand or library like TipTap/Slate. Output: HTML or Markdown.

variants.simple: Create rich text editor with formatting toolbar.
variants.detailed: Create WYSIWYG text editor. Toolbar: flex flex-wrap gap-1 p-2 border-b bg-gray-50. Toolbar buttons: p-2 rounded hover:bg-gray-200, icons for bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, lists, links, headings. Button groups: separated by dividers. Editor area: min-h-[200px] p-4 focus:outline-none, contentEditable div or textarea. Formatting: execCommand or library like TipTap/Slate. Output: HTML or Markdown.
variants.advanced: Create full-featured rich text editor. Toolbar: sticky top, grouped buttons (text style, paragraph, insert). Text formatting: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, highlight colors. Paragraph: headings (H1-H3), bullet list, numbered list, blockquote, code block. Insert: link (modal for URL), image (upload or URL), table, horizontal rule, emoji picker. Alignment: left, center, right, justify. Editor: based on TipTap, Slate, or Lexical for React. Floating toolbar: appears on text selection with quick formatting. Slash commands: type "/" to open insert menu. Mentions: type "@" to mention users with autocomplete. Link preview: paste URL to auto-embed preview. Image handling: drag-drop upload, resize handles, alt text editor. Tables: insert, add/remove rows/cols, merge cells. Code blocks: syntax highlighting with language selector. Markdown shortcuts: type "# " for H1, "- " for bullet, etc. Character count: show in footer with limit warning. Autosave: debounced save to localStorage or API. Collaboration: optional cursor presence for multi-user editing. Output: getHTML(), getJSON(), getMarkdown() methods.
